name: pixel-crew
description: A local multi-agent office for Claude Code and Codex.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.check: npm run check:seo && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:bundle && git diff --check
